buckets.title: Hybridisation, sigma/pi overlap and molecular shape
buckets.badge_reason: Most items require a short conceptual or representational bridge rather than formula execution.

scope.covers: Introductory localized hybrid-orbital descriptions for the supplied BF3/NH3, H2CO, ethene, CO2, CH3F, HCN, methylamine and CH4/NH3/H2O cases.
excluded: Delocalised molecular-orbital treatments, hypervalent models, radicals and amide resonance beyond the supplied questions.

grade9v3:question_repairs.clarify: Conserve carbon orbitals while separating domains from sigma/pi components.
grade9v3:question_repairs.connect: Three sigma directions do not consume the remaining perpendicular p orbital.
grade9v3:question_repairs.way: Assign each carbon valence orbital once: hybrids to sigma, residual p to pi.
grade9v3:question_repairs.rule: HCHO carbon has three-domain sp2 accounting, three sp2 sigma directions and one unhybridised p orbital; C=O has one sigma plus one pi.
grade9v3:question_repairs.check: Changed check: for an sp carbon, two hybrids plus two residual p orbitals still total four basis functions.
grade9v3:question_repairs.probe: Inventory sp2 carbon and sp carbon; can a p orbital used in a hybrid also be counted as a separate residual p?
grade9v3:question_repairs.pattern: No double use. Totals remain four in both cases. Repeated totals above four indicate double counting.
grade9v3:question_repairs.transfer: Inventory HCN carbon without copying the formaldehyde count.
grade9v3:question_repairs.wrong_idea: A carbon p function can be counted in a hybrid and as a residual orbital.
grade9v3:question_repairs.label: Q2

grade9v3:question_repairs.clarify: Construct the relation between the molecular plane and the pi orbitals.
grade9v3:question_repairs.connect: Three sigma directions lie in each sp2 carbon plane; residual p is perpendicular to that plane.
grade9v3:question_repairs.way: Draw both carbon frames, then align the residual p directions for possible lateral overlap.
grade9v3:question_repairs.rule: Ethene has a coplanar sigma framework; the two residual p directions are parallel and perpendicular to it in the introductory model.
grade9v3:question_repairs.check: Changed check: rotate one CH2 group while preserving C-C connectivity; ask which overlap is sensitive to the relative orientation.
grade9v3:question_repairs.probe: Rotate the whole ethene picture, then rotate only one CH2 group. Which operation changes relative p alignment?
grade9v3:question_repairs.pattern: Only the relative-group rotation changes alignment. A whole-page-orientation answer exposes a representation error.
grade9v3:question_repairs.transfer: Sketch a qualitative twisted ethene comparison without predicting a numerical barrier.
grade9v3:question_repairs.wrong_idea: Page orientation is the same as relative orbital orientation.
grade9v3:question_repairs.label: Q3

grade9v3:question_repairs.clarify: The central carbon inventory must support two directions and two pi components.
grade9v3:question_repairs.connect: sp accounting leaves two mutually perpendicular p directions.
grade9v3:question_repairs.way: Allocate carbon basis functions and bond components in separate ledgers; keep the localized drawing explicitly a model.
grade9v3:question_repairs.rule: CO2 carbon: two domains/sp, two sigma components and two pi components. A localized VB drawing is useful accounting, not a unique experimentally compulsory terminal-O orbital-plane picture.
grade9v3:question_repairs.check: Changed check: HCN carbon also has two sigma directions and two residual p directions although its neighbours differ.
grade9v3:question_repairs.probe: Give carbon orbital inventory for CO2 and HCN. Does a localized drawing uniquely measure the oxygen orbital basis?
grade9v3:question_repairs.pattern: Both carbon inventories close at four. No unique O basis follows from the drawing alone. Repeated uniqueness claims expose model/observation conflation.
grade9v3:question_repairs.transfer: State what CO2 geometry supports and what it cannot uniquely prove.
grade9v3:question_repairs.wrong_idea: A localized CO2 drawing uniquely measures the terminal oxygen basis.
grade9v3:question_repairs.label: Q4

grade9v3:question_repairs.clarify: Keep local inventories separate from the triple-bond component inventory.
grade9v3:question_repairs.connect: One bonded neighbour supplies one direction even when three bond components are present.
grade9v3:question_repairs.way: At C and N count local sigma directions/lone pairs, then tally one sigma plus residual pi components.
grade9v3:question_repairs.rule: HCN carbon and nitrogen have introductory sp local accounting; C-N contains one sigma and two pi components.
grade9v3:question_repairs.check: Changed check: total valence electrons HCN = 1+4+5 = 10; the three shared pairs and N lone pair plus C-H pair use all ten.
grade9v3:question_repairs.probe: Compare domain counts at C and N with the total number of shared pairs in HCN.
grade9v3:question_repairs.pattern: Both local domain counts are two; four shared pairs plus N lone pair close the ten-electron ledger. Repeated multiplicity-as-domain confusion changes the local totals.
grade9v3:question_repairs.transfer: Compare HCN and CO2 local carbon inventories.
grade9v3:question_repairs.wrong_idea: Three C-N bond lines supply three C-centred directions.
grade9v3:question_repairs.label: Q7

grade9v3:question_repairs.clarify: Avoid spending a carbon basis function twice.
grade9v3:question_repairs.connect: For second-period carbon, one 2s and three 2p functions form a four-dimensional valence basis.
grade9v3:question_repairs.way: Assign three hybrid sigma directions and reserve only unused functions for the pi job.
grade9v3:question_repairs.rule: sp2 accounting is three hybrid orbitals plus one residual p. A p function already mixed into a hybrid is not simultaneously counted as an additional residual orbital.
grade9v3:question_repairs.check: Changed check: sp accounting gives two hybrids plus two residual p; sp3 gives four hybrids plus zero residual p.
grade9v3:question_repairs.probe: Build an allocation ledger for sp, sp2, sp3 and flag any duplicate-use entry.
grade9v3:question_repairs.pattern: All totals four; residual p counts 2,1,0. Recurrent five-orbital totals indicate double counting.
grade9v3:question_repairs.transfer: Allocate the sp2 basis without memorising an orbital picture.
grade9v3:question_repairs.wrong_idea: An input p function can be spent twice in the orbital inventory.
grade9v3:question_repairs.label: Q9

microtopics.title: Sigma/pi orbital inventory without double-counting
microtopics.badge_reason: The learner must translate between Lewis domains and a 3D orbital-overlap representation while preserving two different counting systems.
microtopics.inferential_jump: Build the sigma-direction frame first, then allocate only the remaining unhybridised p orbital(s) to pi overlap; never count a pi component as a new sigma/domain direction.

teaching_path.action: Keep the domain-direction ledger separate from the sigma/pi bond-component ledger.
teaching_path.why_valid: A multiple bond is one local direction even though it contains more than one bond component.

teaching_path.action: Construct the hybrid sigma framework from the local domain count, then identify the unhybridised p orbital(s) left over.
teaching_path.why_valid: Hybridisation changes the basis used for the sigma framework while leaving specific p directions available for pi overlap.

teaching_path.action: Orient remaining p orbitals for side-on overlap: perpendicular to an sp2 molecular plane, or as two independent p directions around an sp linear axis.
teaching_path.why_valid: Pi overlap requires parallel p orbitals and is geometrically distinct from sigma overlap along the axis.

teaching_path.action: Close the inventory by checking each local valence orbital has one assigned role and each multiple bond has exactly one sigma component.
teaching_path.why_valid: This catches double-counting and domain/component conflation.

grade9v3:question_repairs.clarify: Compare full local inventories, not only the common three sigma bonds.
grade9v3:question_repairs.connect: A central lone pair adds a domain even though it adds no bonded nucleus.
grade9v3:question_repairs.way: Make two columns: bonded neighbours and central lone pairs; connect totals to geometry yourself.
grade9v3:question_repairs.rule: BF3 has three B domains; NH3 has three bonds plus one N lone pair. Introductory sp2/planar versus sp3-like domain/pyramidal shape follows the local model.
grade9v3:question_repairs.check: Changed check: H2O and NH3 have different numbers of bonds but the same four-domain total.

grade9v3:question_repairs.clarify: Count local domains and bonded nuclei at two different centres.
grade9v3:question_repairs.connect: A lone pair contributes to electron-domain geometry but is excluded from molecular-shape naming.
grade9v3:question_repairs.way: Use separate C and N inventories; do not carry a whole-molecule label from one atom to the other.
grade9v3:question_repairs.rule: Methylamine C has four bonded directions; N has three bonded directions and one lone pair. Introductory tetrahedral C and pyramidal N nuclear arrangements differ despite four-domain totals.
grade9v3:question_repairs.check: Changed check: replacing N-H with N-CH3 preserves the local three-bond-plus-lone-pair N inventory in the neutral localized amine model.
grade9v3:question_repairs.probe: Compare local N inventory with carbon inventory in CH3NH2. Which centre includes a lone-pair direction?
grade9v3:question_repairs.pattern: N does; C does not. Using one atom-global shape for both reveals locality confusion.
grade9v3:question_repairs.transfer: Describe a neutral secondary amine N without predicting an exact experimental angle.
grade9v3:question_repairs.wrong_idea: One whole-molecule label determines both carbon and nitrogen shapes.
grade9v3:question_repairs.label: Q8

grade9v3:question_repairs.clarify: Test whether domain geometry and nuclear shape are interchangeable.
grade9v3:question_repairs.connect: A lone-pair domain has no bonded nucleus to include in molecular-shape naming.
grade9v3:question_repairs.way: Hold four domains fixed and vary how many slots are bonded atoms.
grade9v3:question_repairs.rule: CH4, NH3, H2O have four introductory domains but tetrahedral, pyramidal and bent nuclear shapes respectively.
grade9v3:question_repairs.check: Changed check: a four-bond/no-lone-pair centre cannot be assigned the same atom-only shape as a two-bond/two-lone-pair centre.
grade9v3:question_repairs.probe: For four-domain inventories with 4,3,2 bonded atoms, give the atom-only shape and explain omitted slots.
grade9v3:question_repairs.pattern: Tetrahedral, pyramidal, bent; omitted slots are lone pairs. Repeating tetrahedral for all atom-only shapes exposes the conflation.
grade9v3:question_repairs.transfer: Sketch the domain and atom-only inventories separately for H2O.
grade9v3:question_repairs.wrong_idea: Four-domain geometry equals the atom-only shape in every case.
grade9v3:question_repairs.label: Q10
